name: metabase
description: Search, query, and visualize data from your Metabase instance inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Search, query, and visualize data from your Metabase instance.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a Metabase instance via the Metabase MCP server. Search tables and metrics, construct queries against the semantic layer, execute them, and create saved questions and dashboards — all scoped to your Metabase permissions through OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Use Metabase to find tables related to <topic>.
